name: @dancingteeth/agent-looper
description: Agent Looper — repo-agnostic fix-until-green harness (Cursor / Cline / OpenCode / Pi / Codex / DSH; configurable reviewRuntime judge)
author: Paul Zgordan

scripts.test: pnpm test:dsh-plugin:deps && vitest run && node --test scripts/prepare-package.test.mjs && node --test plugins/agent-looper/skills/check-running-loops/check-running-loops.test.mjs
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm test:dsh-plugin:deps && vitest run --coverage && node --test scripts/prepare-package.test.mjs && node --test plugins/agent-looper/skills/check-running-loops/check-running-loops.test.mjs
scripts.agent:loop: doppler run --project agent-looper --config dev -- node dist/cli/run.js
scripts.agent:check: doppler run --project agent-looper --config dev -- node dist/cli/check.js cursor
scripts.agent:check:cline: doppler run --project agent-looper --config dev -- node dist/cli/check.js cline
scripts.agent:check:opencode: doppler run --project agent-looper --config dev -- node dist/cli/check.js opencode
scripts.agent:check:pi: doppler run --project agent-looper --config dev -- node dist/cli/check.js pi
scripts.agent:check:codex: doppler run --project agent-looper --config dev -- node dist/cli/check.js codex
scripts.agent:check:dsh: doppler run --project agent-looper --config dev -- node dist/cli/check.js dsh
scripts.agent:doctor: doppler run --project agent-looper --config dev -- node dist/cli/doctor.js
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
